newEntriesNeeded.title: PMLTAGS object and GetListDefinition
newEntriesNeeded.principle: PMLTAGS is the entry point for AVEVA Engineering Tags API. GetListDefinition retrieves a list definition by name and grid reference.
newEntriesNeeded.rule: Use !!tags = object PMLTAGS() then !!tags.GetListDefinition(listName, gridName) to access list metadata.
newEntriesNeeded.exampleCanonical:
-- CB mac_22
!!tags = object PMLTAGS()
!gridDef = !!tags.GetListDefinition('15.2 Leirvik Data Export', !listName)
!sourceDbView = !gridDef.DbViewName()
pitfalls: GetListDefinition requires valid list name and grid reference
DbViewName() returns the DbView reference, not a string

newEntriesNeeded.title: DbView sub-object types: ATTCOL and EXPCOL
newEntriesNeeded.principle: ATTCOL (attribute column) and EXPCOL (expression column) are sub-objects within a DbView. Access via .dbref() to get .udname or .DbAttribute.
newEntriesNeeded.rule: var !fields collect all (ATTCOL EXPCOL) for $!dbView, then iterate with do !field values !fields.
newEntriesNeeded.syntax:
var !fields collect all (ATTCOL EXPCOL) for $!sourceDbView
do !field values !fields
  !udname = !field.dbref().udname
  !expression = !field.dbref().DbAttribute
enddo
newEntriesNeeded.exampleCanonical:
-- CB mac_22
!fields = collect all (ATTCOL EXPCOL) for $!sourceDbView
do !field values !fields
  !udname = !field.dbref().udname
  !expression = !field.dbref().DbAttribute
enddo
pitfalls: .DbAttribute may throw (2,201) if attribute is not directly accessible — fall back to .expression

newEntriesNeeded.title: OLD prefix for delta queries on ENGITEM
newEntriesNeeded.principle: The OLD keyword before 'collect all' queries the delta (deleted/modified) state of ENGITEM objects. Combined with MODIFIED(), DELETED(), CREATED() predicates.
newEntriesNeeded.rule: var !deletedTags OLD collect all (ENGITEM) with ( DELETED() ) to get deleted tags.
newEntriesNeeded.exampleAntipattern: Using OLD without predicate — returns all items, not just delta
pitfalls: MODIFIED() and DELETED() require OLD prefix; CREATED() does not
OLD queries the comparison state set by SETCOMPDATE

newEntriesNeeded.title: SETCOMPDATE STAMP for tag comparison context
newEntriesNeeded.principle: SETCOMPDATE STAMP sets the comparison date context so that OLD collect queries return delta data relative to a specific stamp.
newEntriesNeeded.rule: SETCOMPDATE STAMP $!latestStamp where !latestStamp is a STAMP object reference.
newEntriesNeeded.syntax:
var !stamps collect all STAMP
!latestStamp = !stamps[2]
SETCOMPDATE STAMP $!latestStamp
newEntriesNeeded.exampleCanonical:
-- CB mac_22
var !stamps collect all STAMP
!latestStamp = !stamps[2]
SETCOMPDATE STAMP $!latestStamp
newEntriesNeeded.exampleAntipattern: Using SETCOMPDATE without prior STAMP collection
pitfalls: Index 2 skips the most recent stamp (index 1)
SETCOMPDATE affects all subsequent OLD collect queries

newEntriesNeeded.title: NetDataSource 3-argument constructor with headers and data
newEntriesNeeded.principle: NetDataSource accepts (name, headers, data) where headers is an array of column names and data is a 2D array of rows.
newEntriesNeeded.rule: !source = object NetDataSource('$!<gridName>', !headerList, !dataList) where !dataList is ARRAY of ARRAY.
newEntriesNeeded.exampleAntipattern: Passing flat array as data — causes column misalignment
pitfalls: Data must be ARRAY of ARRAY (each row is an ARRAY)
Header count must match column count in each row

newEntriesNeeded.title: findfirst().set() pattern for array membership testing
newEntriesNeeded.principle: Array.findfirst(item) returns the first matching element; .set() checks if a value was assigned, confirming membership.
newEntriesNeeded.rule: Use (!deletedTags.findfirst(!tag).set()) to test if a tag exists in the deleted array.
newEntriesNeeded.exampleCanonical:
-- CB mac_22
if (!deletedTags.findfirst(!tag).set()) then
  !action = |DELETE|
elseif (!createdTags.findfirst(!tag).set()) then
  !action = |NEW|
endif
newEntriesNeeded.exampleAntipattern: Using findfirst() without .set() — always truthy even if no match
pitfalls: findfirst returns the matched element or UNSET; .set() distinguishes these

newEntriesNeeded.title: Syscom MKDIR for directory creation
newEntriesNeeded.principle: Syscom executes system commands. MKDIR creates directories. Use with variable substitution for dynamic paths.
newEntriesNeeded.rule: Syscom |MKDIR "$!publishPath"| to create a directory from a PML variable path.
newEntriesNeeded.exampleAntipattern: Using MKDIR without quotes around variable path
pitfalls: Syscom MKDIR may fail silently if directory already exists
Use !!mkdir() function as alternative in PML2
